questions.subject: DATA_SCIENCE
questions.topic: Rows holding an unattainable rating
questions.stem: Explain how a dispatcher should handle rows with unattainable ratings before modeling.

answer.exemplar: The dispatcher should investigate whether the values are data entry errors or a new valid category, then either correct, remove, or recode them. Leaving them in distorts statistics and can break encodings, while silent deletion loses information.

questions.explanation: Investigate before acting; correction, removal, or recoding each has tradeoffs. The tempting idea that deletion is always safe fails because it loses information.
